description: Proposed change of use from Residential Dwelling (Class C3) to Residential Care Home (Class C2) for up to two children
decision_conditions: <p>Insufficient information has been provided with regards to the loss of the residential floorspace without reprovision, how the proposal would address the local childcare needs and that the development is located within the community is intended to serve would be required. The lack of a legal agreement to secure first refusals for children placements for the London Borough of Harrow would not ensure that the needs of local childcare would be addressed. As such, the proposed change of use would be inappropriate for this site contrary to the relevant provisions in the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H8A and H12 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM24 and DM29 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposed change of use by reason of the lack of a lawful and safe vehicular access for the on-site car parking space and the loss of the on-street parking space in a Controlled Parking Zone without adequate replacement parking spaces, would result in an adverse impacts on traffic congestion and parking pressure along Durham Road and the surrounding highway network and the safe and free flow of the public highway, contrary to Policy T4, T5, T6 and T6.1 of The London Plan (2021) and Policies DM42.E and F and DM43.C, of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>
